components.text: Hi appcrawler5, Thanks for joining! To get started, remember to upload a few photos to your profile. They'll be online within a few minutes and this is the best way to meet guys. We're gay men just like you. Our aim is to create a community for you to find hot dates, great friends or the love of your life. You'll find more free features than anywhere else and a friendly place to call home. Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions. Happy dating! PlanetRomeo Team
